paper_title: First results of the SUPAX Experiment: Probing Dark Photons
notes: Single-frequency proof-of-concept limit from 8.3 GHz copper cavity haloscope. Final claimed limit chi < 6.20e-14 at 95% CL at mA' = 34.34 ueV (f0 = 8303.06 MHz) in randomised polarisation scenario. A fixed-polarisation limit of chi < 38e-14 is also quoted but the primary result is the randomised value.
